text: Craig Thompson's Blankets was challenged at the Marshall Public Library in September 2006 by Louise Mills, a resident of Marshall, Missouri, who sought its removal over illustrations she alleged were obscene and likened to pornography. Under library policy the challenge was referred to the Library Board of Trustees. In March 2007 the board approved a materials selection policy that was immediately applied to Blankets, restoring it to the library collection.
